title: Idoolak derret yan rooci
intro: silaalak kaxxa mawqah qanxaffek, ta cuumih muuci qammaalam garboh addal. Doorimte ummattah miraac qibaadah angaarawih diini qale fan gexe wak, darrel raqte maral kaxxa gibbatu rade. ta numtin amoh uddur yibbixeh inkih tan ayyuntih mabla qagitak weeloysoonuh. Mirac nummat yandabbe wak, baxsaleeh amotani digaala madqimteh. atu tama anaakar kee aylahsiyyi rooci miyya kinnim baxxaqissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu assakat le astooti caylale zulmih gabat currik yewqeh yan mara lih safra.
Ken mirac miracsenta geyuh qale fan gexe wak, anu darrel raqteh tan maritteh fanat qammaala.
Anu gaalik tan birta gaaboyseh ken bilaali kee faashiin tukteenay xongolo murtussa.
ta hadliyyih gabuuk, anu inkih tan hora geysiiseh oson sinni rabbi garbol geenih yaniinim.
Miraac yuduure wak, anu dubuk sugeeh, tannah yan aylahso fan yoo beytem maca kinnim essere.
yi digaala ta baadal num yoo xage waam hinnay xayyoowe waam, anu amotani quukah qaybi asta.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: xaggiime sinniimih nacna, sarrimaaneh 'angaarawa mali' iyyaanama.
Qangiino kee kay qande xaqut culte
Xamca kee salaam bahta girat qid
Aysinu le ramad boodok addat cabeh
outcome.answer: xaggiime sinniimih nacna, sarrimaaneh 'angaarawa mali' iyyaanama.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
